answer: The bug was in `Core::move_index` where the condition `if from == to` was used instead of `if from != to`. This caused the index movement logic to be skipped when it should have been executed, or vice versa depending on the intended behavior. Changing it to `if from != to` correctly handles moving an entry's index in the `IndexMap`.

The bug was in `Core::move_index` where it checked `if from == to` instead of `if from != to`. This caused the move operation to be skipped when the indices were different, leading to incorrect map state and failing tests. I corrected the condition to `if from != to`.
